name: Quiet Footsteps
text: Whenever you lose a trick you played an ace or face card to, gain +15 nil value.

signature.trigger: you lose a trick you played an ace or face card to

archetypes: Nil Champion; splash Blind Bidder, Nil Guard
decision: On a nil, when to shed each high card: under a higher card or a trump, while it is safe, rather than holding it until it is forced to win.
opponent: Visible each time it triggers; opponents can lead low in the suit so your high card has nothing to hide under.
aiNote: On a nil, play your highest card of the suit led whenever a higher card or a trump is already in the trick.
rationale: A nil hand holds three or four aces and face cards and sheds two or three of them safely, so a successful nil gains +30 to +45, about +15 EV, the uncommon nil band. Every trigger is a card you chose to shed at a safe moment.
deviation: Redesigned and renamed from Quiet Omega, which paid for playing last to a trick, something you rarely control.
